review.notes: All 11 physical pages text-diffed against the OCR markdown (normalized); 14 fence lines all balanced. The running header 'The Amazon Nova Sonic model' is absent from the OCR on every page and was treated as page furniture, not droppage. Table 7 (p.10) and the Spanish prompt box (p.10) are embedded as source images rather than transcribed text; both were inspected and their content is visible in the embedded images, so no text restoration was attempted for them. Rendered and visually verified: p.2 and p.5 footnote bands (300 dpi), p.7 reference [7] (300 dpi), p.9 evaluation-period list (170 dpi).
